author: Fextralife
description:
Nodusfall Gameplay Impressions - I PLAYED IT...
In this video, I'm going to be talking about my hands on impressions with Nodusfall. Yes, I got to play the game. I was invited to check it out at Gamescom in Cologne, and honestly, I did not know what to expect when I saw this game. I think there are a lot of people out there that were caught off guard by the announcement at opening night Live as this title is so drastically different from the games that we've seen HoYoverse make in the past. 
But in this video, I want to talk about how the game plays, what the mechanics of it are like, and what you can expect from Nodusfall.
